decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin no later than three years from the date of planning permission P/2021/3805, dated: 06/04/2022.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in this application and the plans submitted:
Drawings 3667 D - LB - XX - 00 - DR - L - 200000 P4, 3667 D - LB - XX - 00 - DR - A - 120000 P4 and 3667 D - LB - XX - 01 - DR - A - 120001 P3, and Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report (July 2021), Daylight and Sunlight Report (July 2021), Fire Safety Statement (26th August 2021), Planning Statement (August 2021), Preliminary Groundwater Screening Assessment, Shadow Study (18th March 2022) and Transport Note (March 2022). All approved 16/04/2022.
Drawing 3667 D - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - A - 130000 (Rev.C). Approved 14/11/2023 (under NMA P/2023/3303).
Cover Letter (dated 1st April 2025) and Amended Energy Statement (008459 Issue 3, dated March 2023), received 06/05/2025. 
BREL Compliance Reports (Units 1-3), Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs) (Units 1-3), Part L Compliance Reports (Units 1-3) and SAP Calculations (Units 1-3), received 28/07/2025.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission, a satisfactory standard of development is secured and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2023/1273, approved on 30/06/2023, and maintained as such thereafter. 
Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2022/3402, approved on 19/12/2022.
Reason. To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved and in the interests of air quality and neighbour amenity.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
Reason: In order not to prejudice the amenities of the adjoining properties and in order that the Local Planning Authority is able to exercise control over future development of the site.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2023/0804, approved on 10/08/2023, and the details approved under application P/2024/2519, approved on 18/09/2024.
Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials.
Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall remain compliant with the revised Energy Strategy (008459 Issue 3, dated March 2023), received 06/05/2025, which is hereby approved, and associated evidence of implementation, which are also hereby approved: BREL Compliance Reports (Units 1-3), Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs) (Units 1-3), Part L Compliance Reports (Units 1-3) and SAP Calculations (Units 1-3), received 28/07/2025.
Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2024/0833, approved on 03/05/2024.
Reason: in order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources and in the interest of sustainable development.
Condition : 9 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2023/0724, approved on 26/07/2023. 
Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area.
Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2023/0672, approved on 10/08/2023. 
Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site, in accordance with relevant policy requirements including but not limited to London Plan policies SI12 and SI13 (and its associated Sustainable Design and Construction SPG), the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems and Local Plan policy EQ3.
Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2024/3508, approved on 12/12/2024.
Reason: To ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed. 
Condition : 12 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2024/2884, approved on 18/09/2024.
Reason: In pursuance of the Council's duty under section 17 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 to consider crime and disorder implications in excising its planning functions; to promote the well-being of the area in pursuance of the Council's powers under section 2 of the Local Government Act 2000 and to ensure the development provides a safe and secure environment.
Condition : 13 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2024/2853, approved on 18/10/2024.
Reason: To ensure that there are adequate servicing facilities within the site in the interests of highway safety. 
Condition : 14 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2023/1646, approved on 09/07/2024, with the installed charging points maintained at all times thereafter.
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport.
Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under application P/2023/1113, approved on 06/06/2024, with the approved facilities fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the details approved under applications: P/2022/3401, approved on 19/12/2022; and P/2024/2641, approved on 18/09/2025. 
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The LPA therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
Supporting notes:
a. An initial phase 1 desk study has been submitted with the original application and is considered satisfactory and a phase 2 intrusive investigation was submitted through discharge of Condition 17 which included investigation into outstanding potential contamination issues and allowed the development of a site Conceptual Model (CM), which identifies all potential pollutant linkages on the site. Risk assessments must adhere to current UK guidance and best practice.
b. Any necessary scheme for decontamination shall provide details of how each potential pollutant linkage, as identified in the conceptual model, will be made safe.
c. In some instances the LPA may require work on site to be ceased whilst the nature of additional contamination is investigated fully.
d. The validation report shall revisit the site conceptual model, and provide evidence that each aspect of the decontamination scheme was carried out correctly and successfully. This report shall prove that the development is suitable for its new use.
e. We request that site investigation reports or site plans be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk or by post on a cd or dvd wherever possible.
description: Variation of condition 7, energy strategy, to allow amendments to the approved energy strategy including a reduction in emissions reductions and a new carbon offset payment element to be introduced of planning permission 01407/ADJ1/P1 approved 06/04/2022 for the erection of three bungalows with associated cycle and waste storage, landscaping and boundary treatment.
